questions.q: Why did the US dollar weaken against the Japanese yen during Tokyo trading hours?
o: Lower US yields compressed rate differentials and pressured the greenback.
The Federal Reserve announced an unexpected emergency interest rate hike.
Japanese importers bought large amounts of foreign currency for trade settlements.
Stock futures surged following major technology earnings reports from Meta and Tesla.
questions.e: Lower US benchmark yields reduce the returns available on dollar-denominated debt, which compresses rate differentials and causes the currency to weaken. Stock earnings reports and importer actions in other regions do not directly drive this specific US debt repricing.

questions.e: Pound futures rallied as incoming data showed energy price pressures pushing headline metrics above 4.0%, leading analysts to anticipate a base rate increase. A rate cut would typically have different effects, and energy costs actually rose rather than collapsed.
